evals.name: healthcare-security-review-readiness
evals.prompt: we're about to put our LangGraph agent platform in front of a hospital system's security team next month. it generates dev tickets from requirement docs, runs on EKS, calls Bedrock. what are they going to ask us and what are we missing?
evals.expected_output: Findings identifying binding layers (HIPAA/HITRUST first, not ISO), the artifact gaps (system cards, data-flow diagram, eval harness, tracing, inventory), and a prioritized order. Should note HITRUST AI assessments and that data residency/PHI-in-prompts is the first question.

evals.name: iso-42001-necessary-or-not
evals.prompt: client's legal is asking whether we need ISO 42001 before they'll sign. do we? we're a small team shipping an internal AI tool for them, US only.
evals.expected_output: A clear NO with reasoning: 6-12 months of a running management system before Stage 2 is passable; ISO 42001 confers no legal obligation and no EU AI Act conformity; recommend AI RMF (free, non-certifiable) plus HIPAA/HITRUST evidence instead. Should not hedge into 'it depends' without a recommendation.
